prompt: Explain what information a GoAI edge carries beyond "paper A cites paper B", and why that extra information matters for helping a student.

private.model_answer: An edge also records the citation position, a proxy for how important the citation is, and one of five semantic labels such as extension, contrast or refutation. This matters because a student needs to know whether a cited paper is a foundation to build on, a baseline to beat, or a critique, so the system can order and choose papers meaningfully.

rubric.criterion: Mentions the citation semantics label (e.g., extension, contrast, refutation, mention) as extra information on the edge.
Mentions citation position as a proxy for importance.
Explains that knowing the role of a citation lets the system or student distinguish relationships such as building on versus merely mentioning.
